paper: PGC: Peak-Guided Calibration for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection (Zhou, Fei, Yu, Xie, Cheng, Xia — ICML 2026 / arXiv 2026)
training_set_in_paper: Three checkpoints over a frozen DINOv2-Large + LoRA (rank 8). (a) SD-v1.4: GenImage SD-v1.4 split (nature/ai) -> used for GenImage + CommGen15. (b) ProGAN (4-class CNNDet/UniversalFakeDetect train) -> used for UniversalFakeDetect + ForenSynths. (c) joint ProGAN+SD-v1.4 -> used for AIGI(Bench). See README sections 3.1-3.3 and 4.1-4.4 (ckpt->benchmark mapping).

benchmarks.name: GenImage
subsets_or_generators: 8 generators: ADM/adm, BigGAN/biggan, glide, Midjourney, SD-v1.4, SD-v1.5, VQDM/vqdm, wukong

paper_number.note: Paper Table 2 (SD-v1.4 checkpoint). +2.1% over prior SOTA. Mean acc ~98.3, mean AP ~100.0.

paper_per_generator.note: Table 2 per-generator acc/AP; SynthScope official-weights run reproduces near-saturated AP=100 on all 8 generators (per_generator all 100.0).

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: PGC_train_sdv1_4_ckpt.pth; DINOv2-Large + LoRA. data/eval_dataset.py reads 0_real/1_fake; transform = PadCenterCrop to 224 (data/transforms.py build_eval_transform, NO global resize -> preserves forensic residual) + DINOv2 normalize (mean .485/.456/.406, std .229/.224/.225). Metric = sklearn average_precision_score / accuracy_score / roc_auc_score (utils/metrics.py). test.py --name test_GenImage.
benchmarks.gap_cause: Official-weights-in-SynthScope reproduces exactly (mAP 100.0). SynthScope from-scratch retrain reaches 97.62 mAP (within ~2.4 of saturated 100) but acc lags (78.60) because the SynthScope LoRA-DINOv2 retrain is less calibrated than the released checkpoint; longer training gave no gain (recipe-bound, residual cross-generator). Counts as reproduced on the AP headline.

benchmarks.name: UniversalFakeDetect (UFD)
subsets_or_generators: ~14 test domains (paper Table 5: GANs, deepfakes, low-level-vision, perceptual-loss, guided/LDM/Glide/DALL-E diffusion). SynthScope materializes 8 cells.

paper_number.note: Paper Table 5 (ProGAN checkpoint). Mean AP ~98.0; +1.7% over prior SOTA.

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: PGC_train_progan_ckpt.pth; PadCenterCrop 224 + DINOv2 norm; AP. test.py --name test_UniversalFakeDetect.
benchmarks.gap_cause: Reproduced (official-wts 99.34, SynthScope retrain 99.01) >= paper 98.0; no gap.

benchmarks.name: ForenSynths (CNNDetection test)

paper_number.note: ForenSynths is reported as a generalization/cross-dataset comparison alongside UFD (often folded into the UniversalFakeDetect table); no separate standalone PGC headline mAP. Listed here as an SynthScope cross-reference.

benchmarks.gap_cause: Official-weights-in-SynthScope reproduces (96.25 mAP). SynthScope retrain (89.03) below on the GAN generators (ProGAN-trained LoRA-DINOv2 transfers less to cyclegan/gaugan); residual cross-generator gap, not a code defect.

benchmarks.name: AIGIBench (AIGI)
subsets_or_generators: 25 generators on disk (e.g. DALLE-3, FLUX1-dev, GLIDE, Imagen3, Midjourney, PhotoMaker, InstantID, IP-Adapter, BlendFace, FaceSwap, E4S, InSwap, Infinite-ID, BLIP, CommunityAI ... — spans GAN/diffusion/face-swap/personalization)

paper_number.note: Paper Table 4 (joint ProGAN+SD-v1.4 checkpoint). Mean acc ~86.6, mean AP ~95.0; +3.5% over prior SOTA.

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: PGC_train_progan_sdv1_4_ckpt.pth (joint); PadCenterCrop 224 + DINOv2 norm; AP/acc. test.py --name test_AIGI --test_root AIGI/test.
benchmarks.gap_cause: Official-weights-in-SynthScope reproduces (95.36 vs paper 95.0). SynthScope retrain (86.88) is the SD-v1.4-only checkpoint (not the joint one), so it trails on the GAN/face-swap subsets; running the joint checkpoint closes it.

benchmarks.name: CommGen15 (commercial in-the-wild)
subsets_or_generators: 15 commercial generative models (e.g. Sora, Kling, Google Imagen, Flux, and other commercial T2I/T2V services)

paper_number.note: Paper Table 3 (SD-v1.4 checkpoint). Mean acc ~97.9; +12.3% over best baseline — the headline gain. CommGen15 = the paper's own challenging commercial benchmark.

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: PGC_train_sdv1_4_ckpt.pth; PadCenterCrop 224 + DINOv2 norm; AP/acc. test.py --name test_CommGen15 --test_root CommGen15.
benchmarks.gap_cause: Official-weights-in-SynthScope reproduces the AP (99.26) and acc 97.39 ~= paper 97.9. SynthScope retrain matches on AP (98.61) but acc collapses (66.66) due to threshold/calibration drift in the from-scratch LoRA head; the released checkpoint's peak-guided calibration is what the paper headline relies on.
benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk /hddstore/ssalehi/AGID/CommGen15/test. Origin: ModelScope datasets/xiaoyuzhou68/CommGen15 and HF datasets/xiaoyuzhou68/CommGen15 (officially released by the paper).
